newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers plunge despite tight supplies.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers plunge despite tight supplies.

text.p: Singapore bunkers plunged on Thursday on thin demand while tracking crude and correcting from previous high prices, traders said.
"Prices have come down quite a bit and enquiries are ultra thin," a major. "But we are being careful because supplies are also quite tight in September."
Bunker 180 cst was quoted down to $118-$122 from Wednesday's $124-$128, while 380-cst fell to $114-$118 from $120-$124.
MDO similarly fell to $205 from $205-$215 and gas oil was down to $215 from $215-$225.
